label: V4.8.10B FORM MANAGER ROW FIT + MOBILE HANDBOOK
notes: Form Manager multi-line fields now support template-row fitting: set the number of printed rows and the line spacing is derived from field height, so wrapped text follows dotted/ruled template lines instead of bunching at the top. Canvas PDF preview uses the same baseline model. Includes the full Form Manager UI cleanup and compact mobile Carrier Service Notebook layout from V4.8.9.
